scope: One existing queued evaluation task, one case and one arm per explicit invocation
inputBoundary: Five frozen JSON inputs must resolve inside tmp/ma24-independent-evaluation; the entry checks snapshot bytes, question text, Gold structure, corpus snapshot, case identity and arm before calling the dedicated runner.
negativeChecks: Missing arguments rejected before file or database access
A JSON file outside the private evaluation directory rejected
Private files with a mismatched frozen Gold hash rejected before task claim
limitation: This does not create queued tasks, authorize spend, freeze the full Gold set, run a real model, collect a dual-arm pair, or prove answer quality.
